title: igidia volubilis
intro: Igidia volubilis, commonly known as the "Climbing Snail Vine", is a plant species in the Bignoniaceae family that is native to tropical regions. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and providing relief from respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Igidia volubilis are attributed to its ability to relax smooth muscles, reduce fever, and act as an antispasmodic agent. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
